method: Independent blind semantic review (Codex as DaF/SD1 examiner, read-only): each unit solved from text, statement and alphabetically ordered options only — no key, evidence, rival or explanation — and judged for one supported answer, refutation (not silence), referents, natural German, a plausible text purpose and taught meanings. Round 1 reviewed all 64 units (51 OK, 13 FIX, every answer as keyed); the 13 were fixed and round 2 re-reviewed exactly those (7 OK, 6 FIX: phone numbers spelled out in words, one sign wording); the 6 were fixed and round 3 re-reviewed exactly those (5 OK, 1 FIX: a tandem ad offered Arabic its writer does not speak); that unit was rewritten and round 4 re-reviewed it. Every round reviewed only units whose text changed. `solved` and `evidence` are the reviewer's; `round` says which review covers the current text.
